anchors.name: LCDM
anchors.source_context_30_lines:
35: The DESI central values have shifted during the project's lifetime as the collaboration released updated analyses and supernova calibration combinations:
   36: 
   37: | Date | DESI Release / Combination | w_0 | σ(w_0) | w_a | σ(w_a) | FW Tension | Session |
   38: |:-----|:---------------------------|:---:|:------:|:---:|:------:|:----------:|:-------:|
   39: | 2026-02 | DR2 (early, CMB+BAO) | **-0.83** | 0.09 | -0.45 | 0.31 | 1.9σ (FW was w=-1 then) | S22 |
   40: | 2026-03 | DR2 + Pantheon+ SN | **-0.827** | 0.063 | — | — | — | S42 |
   41: | 2026-03 | DR2 + DESY5 SN (current) | **-0.752** | 0.057 | -0.73 | 0.25 | 2.91σ | S67-68 |
   42: 
   43: **Key observation**: DESI's w_0 has drifted from -0.83 toward -0.75 (away from framework) while w_a has grown more negative (-0.45 → -0.73, away from both framework and LCDM). The error bars have tightened (0.09 → 0.057). The supernova calibration choice (Pantheon+ vs DESY5 vs Union3) drives ~0.08 systematic shift in w_0.
   44: 
   45: ### Current State
   46: 
   47: | Observable | Framework Prediction | Current (DR2 + DESY5) | Current Tension | DR3 Projected σ |
   48: |:-----------|:-------------------:|:--------------:|:---------------:|:---------------:|
   49: | w_0 | **-0.918** | -0.752 ± 0.057 | 2.91σ | ± 0.040 |
   50: | w_a | **0** (exactly, four-fold locked) | -0.73 ± 0.25 | 2.92σ | ± 0.177 |
   51:

  129: | **LCDM** | -1.0 | N/A (Λ) | 1.000 | No DE perturbations |

anchors.name: f_NL (equilateral)
anchors.source_context_30_lines:
195: 
  196: **What it measures**: High-resolution CMB temperature + polarization → n_s, α_s, r, f_NL.
  197: 
  198: | Observable | Framework Prediction | Planck 2018 | Current Tension | CMB-S4 σ |
  199: |:-----------|:-------------------:|:-----------:|:---------------:|:--------:|
  200: | n_s | **0.9595** | 0.9649 ± 0.0042 | 1.29σ | ~ 0.002 |
  201: | α_s | **0.000** (exact) | -0.0045 ± 0.0067 | 0.67σ | ~ 0.003 |
  202: | r | **0.0242** | < 0.036 | PASS | 0.003 |
  203: | f_NL (equilateral) | **0.853** | -26 ± 47 | 0.57σ | ~ 5.0 |
  204: | f_NL (folded) | **0.129** | unconstrained | — | ~ 6.9 |
  205: 
  206: **Pre-registered finding**: f_NL is **undetectable** by CMB-S4. Equilateral at 0.17σ, folded at 0.02σ — both buried in noise. n_s tightens to ± 0.002, which would test the structural 1.25σ gap (Lizzi: no smooth cutoff can reach Planck central). α_s = 0 prediction strengthens with tighter error bars.
  207: 
  208: **Why it matters**: CMB-S4 sharpens the n_s and α_s constraints but cannot detect the bispectrum. If n_s tightens to exclude 0.9595, the fold curvature d²S/dτ² is wrong. Source: S68 W2-B, W2-D.
  209:
